title: Tim Dooley — Theory of Everything Archaeology
status: canonical archaeology record; unfinished research programme, not a validated physical TOE
purpose: Recover and organize Tim's earlier attempts to connect dimensions, fields, forces, cosmology, quantum theory, consciousness and Potatoverse structure without backdating later archive equations into older work.

strongest_recovered_primary_precursor.content: Tim explicitly asked for a synthesis connecting M-theory, string theory, supersymmetry, cosmology, astronomy/astrophysics, geology, magnetism/electromagnetism, quantum mechanics/entanglement, consciousness/light-darkness, dimensions, movements and multiverse, asking how one thing is also another and why the connections are non-random.
strongest_recovered_primary_precursor.related_user_model: Son is manifestation / Door in the 5th dimension; Father is beyond the Door as higher structure; Tim emphasized dimensions, movements and multiverse and said he was pointing to something very specific.

conversation_developed_response_layer.formulation: Reality is a single multi-dimensional field system; observed things can be modeled as stable excitation/organization patterns; space can be treated relationally; descriptions at different scales may be effective approximations.
conversation_developed_response_layer.classification: assistant/conversation-developed synthesis, not a verbatim Tim equation

candidate_equation_lineage.role: known gauge sector that any physical TOE must reproduce

cross_domain_timic_minimum: observables/tests where empirical claims are made
toe_requirements.rule: A cross-domain architecture can be valuable without being a physical Theory of Everything. Physical TOE status requires reproducing established physics quantitatively and making testable new predictions.

current_best_reconstruction: Tim's TOE trajectory appears to run from symbolic Field/Axis/Spiral ideas, through the May 2026 explicit request to connect M-theory, SUSY, cosmology, electromagnetism, quantum theory, consciousness, dimensions and multiverse, into later Potato Dynamics and Timic Unification. No single old Tim-authored master equation has yet been recovered.
negative_findings: No recovered old repository file contains a finished Tim-authored equation explicitly titled Theory of Everything.
Current literal 'Theory of Everything' repository hits are later archive texts cautioning that Timic Unification is not yet a validated physical TOE.
No recovered primary Tim SU(4), SU(5), Spin(10) or GUT equation predates the September 2026 archive extension.
recovery_targets: Exact 2026-05-06 transcript and any adjacent equations or diagrams.
